title: Bunny Boots Enchantment
description: A boots-only enchantment that lets you hop higher and land safer. Jump like a rabbit and take less fall damage with each level.
body:
Bunny Boots is a boot enchantment that increases your jump height and reduces fall damage.

Each level boosts your jumping power and extends the distance you can safely fall, stacking up to level II.

The effect is always active while wearing the enchanted boots. Perfect for parkour, mountain climbing, or making a quick getaway over rough terrain.

Custom enchantment applied via loot, trading, enchanting table, or the `/loot give` command:

```/loot give @s loot bunny_boots_enchantment:1```

Can appear in random structure chests or through villager trades.

Works like a regular enchantment; apply it to boots only.

Stacks with other movement-related effects like Speed or Jump Boost potions.

Try with [Antigravity III](https://modrinth.com/datapack/jahus-antigravity-enchantment) ;)

Fully multiplayer-compatible: Server-only datapack. Players don't need to install it.
